slides.headline: 800 VIOLATIONS LATER, MUSK'S TUNNELS ARE WORTH $20 BILLION
$5.7B → $20B IN FOUR YEARS
slides.body: The Boring Company is in talks to raise $4 billion at a $20 billion valuation, per the Wall Street Journal — up from $5.7 billion in 2022. The jump comes despite Nevada regulators citing nearly 800 environmental violations and serious worker injuries in its Las Vegas tunnels, where Teslas already shuttle riders. Next: Nashville, Dubai, and pitches in Baltimore, Chicago and LA

slides.headline: INVESTORS PAY FOR EXECUTION, NOT PERFECTION
slides.body: Capital keeps flowing to operators who ship while everyone else debates. The same rule now applies to AI: businesses automating real operations today are compounding an advantage the wait-and-see crowd can't buy back later. Messy and moving beats clean and stalled
